name: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs | Qwen
description:
GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DEMO DISCORD
Introduction In this blog, we delve into the details of our latest Qwen2.5 series language models. We have developed a range of decoder-only dense models, with seven of them open-sourced, spanning from 0.5B to 72B parameters. Our research indicates a significant interest among users in models within the 10-30B range for production use, as well as 3B models for mobile applications. To meet these demands, we are open-sourcing Qwen2.

name: Windows Camera - Free download and install on Windows | Microsoft Store
description:
The Camera app is faster and simpler than ever. Just point and shoot to take great pictures automatically on any PC or tablet running Windows 10.

• While recording video, pause and resume whenever you want—the Camera app can automatically stitch them all together into one video, so you can skip the boring parts and capture only what’s important.
• Use the timer to get yourself into the shot.
• Compose the perfect picture with the framing grid.
• Automatically back up your photos to OneDrive so you can get to them from any device, including your phone.


And if your device’s hardware supports it, you can:
• Save time by taking a photo of a whiteboard instead of writing it all down—the Camera app automatically makes the shot more readable. *(1,2)
• Stop going to the scanner. Just take a photo of any document—new modes enhance the photo so it’s legible. *(1,2)
• Capture more of the scene with a panorama. *(1,2)
• Shoot smoother videos, even if your hands shake, thanks to digital video stabilization. *(4)
• Capture the range of contrast and get greater detail in both bright and dark areas of the shot with HDR (High Dynamic Range). *(4)

 
*1 Requires world facing camera
*2 Requires camera supporting 1080p or greater resolution
*3 Requires camera supporting 4K resolution
*4 Available on select devices with supporting hardware

name: Le réseau cliniquement intégré d’Arthur Health utilise Microsoft Power Platform pour réduire les temps d’attente des patients de 80 % | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Arthur Health, une entreprise de solutions de soins de santé basée au Canada, réinvente des modèles de soins traditionnellement compartimentés grâce à une approche de réseau cliniquement intégrée. En 2019, Arthur Health s’est associée au ministère de la Santé et des Soins de longue durée de l’Ontario et au Réseau universitaire de santé pour mettre à l’échelle un modèle clinique de soins de la lombalgie. Dans le cadre d’un projet pilote, cela a entraîné une réduction soutenue des temps d’attente, un meilleur accès aux soins locaux et une plus grande satisfaction des patients et des prestataires. Arthur Health prévoit donc de l’étendre. Arthur Health a utilisé la plateforme MazikCare du partenaire Microsoft Quisitive et les technologies Microsoft pour développer une solution centrée sur le patient qui, espère-t-elle, suscitera des changements dans les soins primaires et spécialisés au Canada.

name: Microsoft Defender : téléchargement et installation gratuits sous Windows | Microsoft Store
description:
Simplifiez votre sécurité en ligne avec une application simple d’utilisation qui vous protège, ainsi que celle de votre famille. Microsoft Defender est une application de sécurité destinée aux individus et aux familles qui permet de protéger les données et les appareils contre les menaces en ligne. L'application Microsoft Defender est disponible exclusivement avec un abonnement Microsoft 365 Personnel ou Famille.

Étendre la protection de votre appareil
Sur votre PC, Microsoft Defender fonctionne avec des Sécurité Windows intégrés pour fournir une protection antivirus d’appareil supplémentaire sur vos appareils Android, iOS et MacOS.

Sécurité en ligne, simplifiée
Gérez facilement les protections des données et des appareils de votre famille et des vôtres dans un tableau de bord unique. Restez à jour avec les notifications et alertes de sécurité en temps opportun sur vos ordinateurs et téléphones.

Pour commencer, téléchargez l’application et connectez-vous avec votre compte Microsoft. Un abonnement Microsoft 365 Personnel ou Famille valide est nécessaire pour activer Defender sur vos appareils. Vérifiez l'état de votre abonnement ici : https://account.microsoft.com/

L’application Microsoft Defender est également disponible pour vos appareils Android, iOS et MacOS. Dans l'application, vous pouvez envoyer une invitation à télécharger Microsoft Defender sur vos autres appareils. Vous pouvez également accéder facilement à votre tableau de bord sur mydefender.microsoft.com lorsque vous êtes en déplacement.

- Upload your own images or create AI-generated images.

name: Softools helps customers automate business processes and maximize cloud spend investments through the Microsoft commercial marketplace | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Softools is a fully integrated, quick to learn, powerful, enterprise-grade, no-code web application platform. It enables companies and teams with no coding skills to develop applications to digitize and automate business processes that are often unaddressed by ERP solutions and managed via spreadsheets and email or on paper.  Through the Microsoft commercial marketplace and ISV Success, Softools is streamlining the procurement journey, reaching more customers, and helping existing ones maximize their cloud spend.

name: The power of partnership: Profisee and Microsoft—collaborating to serve customers better, together | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Profisee is a leading provider of master data management (MDM) solutions with a deeply integrated suite of offerings that provide a unified approach to data governance. Profisee is a long-standing Microsoft partner with deep integration spanning technology, partner ecosystem initiatives, and more recently specialized ISV Success benefits. The partnership is paying dividends for Profisee and its Azure customers are benefiting by using their enterprise data more efficiently to drive business.

name: Maidenhead Bridge uses marketplace to magnify and scale worldwide | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Maidenhead Bridge is a leader in the emerging category of multicloud network software providers. Its unique solution lets customers connect from any virtual platform and cloud with Cloud Security Connectors for Secure Service Edge (SSE) vendors. With help from the ISV Success program, it has successfully adopted the commercial marketplace as core to its go-to-market strategy—propelling Maidenhead Bridge to scale and reach global customers.

name: TMI Systems’ Verto 365 harnesses the power of the commercial marketplace to scale and reach new markets | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Verto 365 is a collaborative workplace management solution from TMI Systems. This nimble UK-based company of 20 is using the Microsoft commercial marketplace and ISV Success to make huge strides in expanding transactable offers, increasing scalability, and reaching new geographies. By taking advantage of specific ISV Success benefits and working closely with Bytes, a UK-based cloud service provider, the team behind Verto 365 has accelerated its Microsoft Teams integration and time to market.

name: Signly builds with Microsoft Azure for a more inclusive future in tech innovation | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Signly is a technology-driven startup that aims to address communication barriers faced by the Deaf community. Despite ongoing efforts to enhance accessibility, the Deaf community continues to grapple with significant challenges. Signly recognises the unique nature of sign language, asserting that it deserves recognition and promotion Signly recognizes the distinctive nature of sign language, asserting it deserves both acknowledgment and to be part of the mainstream. To address this critical need, Signly is creating revolutionary technology that assists hearing individuals in communicating with sign language users.

name: ISV Success program helps Akouo bring to market a simultaneous interpretation solution for Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Customer Stories
description: Founded in 2021 and based in the United Kingdom, Akouo’s solution provides universal and simultaneous multilingual interpretation for meetings directly within Microsoft Teams. Users simply add Akouo to their Teams meeting and participants select their preferred language. By tapping into the resources of the ISV Success program, Akouo has moved from development in October of 2021 to a transaction-ready solution that will soon be published on the commercial marketplace.

name: MySims™: Cozy Bundle Home - Electronic Arts
description:
Befriend Cute Characters and discover creative adventures across retro re-releases of two lovable games in MySims: Cozy Bundle: MySims and MySims Kingdom. Use your imagination to rebuild a town in MySims and help a cute magical land become an even better place in MySims Kingdom. There are stories to uncover, locations to explore, and lots of characters with big personalities to meet.

Rediscover the charm of two classic MySims games. Fan-favorite characters are waiting to meet you, and a lot of them need your help. There is just one key element missing from these games — your creative touch! It’s time to craft the cutest worlds you can imagine.

Play Two Charming Stories — Relax with charming tales of creativity and discovery. Explore two worlds full of puzzles to solve, locations to unlock, and quirky townies in need of help.

Customize Cute Sims & Decorate Their Worlds — Create adorable Sims and customize the worlds around them. Unlock clothes and build options as you complete different tasks; there are so many options to discover in both games.

Befriend Cute Characters — Meet funny, friendly characters filled with personality. Some will be with you the whole time, and others you’ll meet as you play and explore. Help them, and they’ll inspire you to get even more creative. You’re not only building houses, you’re also building communities of memorable, adorable townies.

If you want to review something later on, you can always take a look at our Privacy Center. We designed it to give you easy-to-digest summaries of our privacy practices. Until you are at long last reunited with your lost sibling and bear witness to the culmination of all things at the end of your journey.
